short_description: R3 candidate defining missing cross-domain foundations, ownership boundaries, parallel contract waves and long-range convergence milestones.
purpose: Extend GLOBAL-P0 R2 with Identity, Authorization, Reference Frames, Time, Spatial Domain, Material, World Operation, World Query, Lifecycle, Work Budget, Compatibility and Security foundations while preserving accepted domain/runtime ownership.
expected_outcome: A reviewable R3 architecture change-set that can be promoted in main before selected Wave A contract branches are activated.
progress_note: Candidate architecture, machine-readable program map, ownership candidate and parallel implementation plan are present. No production runtime path is changed. R3 explicitly preserves A1/S0/S1/M0, existing domain owners and B1/B2/N3-N6 ordering. The recommended first contract wave is IAM0/IAM1 + MAT0 + WT0 + WQ0/WQ1, with RF/TF/AUTHZ/LIFE/WB/COMPAT following after first contract freeze.
next_stage: Review R3 ownership/intersections, then merge candidate to main, promote revision to GLOBAL-P0-2026-08-11-R3, update canonical ownership/config, run PC0, and register only selected Wave A frontiers.

ownership_claims.scope: candidate proposes future owner names but does not change main project state
